title: Aspire Magnum Pod Vape Kit
description: The Aspire Magnum Pod Kit is a high-performance Direct-to-Lung (DTL) device that bridges the gap between simple pod systems and powerful sub-ohm mods. Designed with a distinct "E-Shisha" style form factor, the Magnum is built for vapers who demand serious endurance and dense vapour production without the bulk of a traditional box mod. At the heart of the device is a colossal 3800mAh built-in battery, one of the largest available in the pod kit category. This impressive capacity ensures extended vaping sessions, easily lasting a full day or more for most users. When recharging is finally needed, the 2A USB-C fast charging capabilities get you back up to speed with minimal downtime. The device operates on a smart Constant Output system, delivering a steady 3.15V to the coil. This ensures that your vaping experience remains consistent from the first puff to the last, without the drop in performance often seen as battery life depletes. Beyond raw performance, the Magnum is engineered for safety and reliability through the advanced Aspire ASP Chipset. This intelligent onboard technology provides a comprehensive suite of safety protections, including safeguards against short circuits, overcharging, low voltage, overheating, and over-time usage. Whether you are pushing the device to its limits or charging it on the go, the ASP Chipset ensures total peace of mind. The Magnum uses a transparent, visually striking chassis available in a range of bold graphic themes like "Funky Skull" and "Cyber Bear," accentuated by subtle LED indicators that keep you informed of device status. It features an adjustable top airflow system, allowing you to fine-tune your draw from a loose, airy DTL inhale to a more restricted feel. The kit includes the refillable Magnum Pod, which utilises integrated mesh coil technology for rapid heating and exceptional flavour clarity. The 2ml pods feature a convenient side-fill mechanism and are optimised for use with High-VG e-liquids (70% VG or higher). With its combination of raw battery power, striking aesthetics, and hassle-free operation, the Aspire Magnum is the ultimate choice for sub-ohm vapers seeking portability and performance. Explore our wide range of vape juice online and pick the perfect partner for this kit. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Pods, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
